aliasPolicy: Whole-token aliases only; explicit types on every token. No extends, root, resolver modules or composite values.

conversions.web: sRGB to CSS; layout px remains px.
conversions.android: sRGB to ARGB; adopted layout px becomes dp as an explicit logical-unit policy. No typography/sp/rem conversions.

web.reason: Preserve existing Svelte title #3d2e22 and 8px row gap (also separates adjacent children).

android.reason: Preserve existing Glance title #2e1e19 and 7dp marker-to-title padding.

roles.meaning: Gap between a leading item affordance/marker and title, within native row structure.
